svg.title: A bit more room. A bit more tea.
svg.desc: An illustrated cleanup: review an old node_modules folder, then turn 1.2 GB of credited space into 12 golden chips in a paper tray. Example numbers, not a live scan.
svg.text: A careful clean. A small reward.
Review first. You choose what goes.
1.2 GB credited. A little more for the paper.
100 MB credited = 1 chip. 1,000 chips = a battered fish.
